note: 60 jobs: the 56 events of docs/audio_event_map.json (same ids, same duration, same loop flag) plus 4 music jobs. The 22 jobs whose event uses the owner's files (the 11 ult_* from pumpkin_slayer_ultimates_sfx.zip, 6 throw_* and impact_flame from the sfx v3 set, 4 status_* of 2026-11-22) are OWNER-SUPPLIED: their prompt says so and they are not meant to be generated. 'duration' is the final length in seconds. 'gen_seconds' is what the model is asked for (a little longer for one-shots, so silence trimming has room). Seeds used are seed_base + variant number (1..3). Post-processing: mono (sfx only), trim silence (threshold relative to the clip peak), fade 5 ms in / 30 ms out, normalise to -3 dBFS, and for loops an 80 ms loop crossfade INSTEAD of the fades (a fade would put a dip at the loop seam). negative_prompt is used by Stable Audio Open 1.0. Nobody has heard any output, see docs/audio_generation_options.md.
